retrieval_query_or_filters: Metadata-only review of the open v2020 Global Active Faults Database product. No repository archive or GIS data bytes were acquired.
intended_use: Global tectonic-source and active-fault context for seismic-hazard research, source-model comparison and event-to-fault linkage. The database is not a probabilistic hazard curve, ground-motion field or loss model.

licensing.attribution_requirements: Provide attribution required by CC BY-SA 4.0 and cite the GEM Global Active Faults Database and relevant constituent/reference sources.
licensing.share_alike_or_derivative_requirements: Derivatives/adaptations are subject to CC BY-SA 4.0 ShareAlike unless a separate tailored licence agreement applies; this admission covers the open CC BY-SA version only.
licensing.notes: GEM's authoritative product page identifies the latest open version as v2020 and its licence as CC BY-SA 4.0. The database is assembled from constituent regional datasets and is designed to evolve; this admission pins v2020 rather than an unversioned repository head.

redistribution.conditions: The open v2020 source is redistributable under CC BY-SA 4.0 subject to attribution/share-alike. OpenCatastrophe approves metadata only and has not identified or hashed an exact archive/file set.

privacy.notes: The reviewed open product contains scientific active-fault geometries and attributes, not personal or confidential insured information.

spatial.extent: Global active-fault compilation; coverage and attribute completeness vary geographically

temporal.extent: v2020 compiled active-fault reference; fault activity attributes refer to geological/tectonic time scales rather than event timestamps

variables_and_units.name: fault geometry
variables_and_units.description: Mapped active-fault traces/geometry compiled from regional sources.

variables_and_units.name: slip rate
variables_and_units.description: Fault slip-rate information where supplied; completeness and uncertainty vary by source and fault.

review.notes: Metadata-only approval for open v2020. Future raw work must pin exact repository/archive identity, preserve constituent-source references, geometry/attribute uncertainty and ShareAlike conditions, and record byte hashes outside Git before asset review.
